1. (Currently Amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__ and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit __wherein said trigger bit is recognized by said module as a control signal separate from data content__.

2. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an analog signal__.

3. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform synthesis __wherein the waveform synthesis is performed independently of waveform digitization__.

4. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said predefined bit is distinct from said trigger bit__.

5. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

6. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises generating said trigger event at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger events during a single period of said single clock source.

7. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 6 wherein said triggering an event comprises altering a data bit period prior to said trigger event and altering a data bit period after said trigger event.

8. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 1 further comprising generating at least two data bit periods at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source.

9. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises generating said trigger event at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger events during a single period of said single clock source; and further comprising generating at least two data bit periods at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source.

10. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 9 wherein said at least two trigger events are interleaved with said at least two data bit periods.

11. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __that is distinct from data bits in said send packet__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits __wherein said trigger bits are recognized by said module as control signals separate from data content__.

12. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an analog signal__.

13. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __initiating__ waveform digitization __of an analog signal__ and waveform synthesis __of a separate analog signal__ on separate channels of said module.

14. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said predefined bit is distinct from said trigger bit__.

15. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

16. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform synthesis __wherein the waveform synthesis is performed independently of waveform digitization__.

17. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein said trigger bit comprises at least two trigger bits at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger bits during a single period of said single clock source.

18. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 further comprising at least one data field, said at least one data field generated at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source.

19. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein said trigger bit comprises at least two trigger bits at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source, thereby generating at least two trigger bits during a single period of said single clock source; and at least two data fields, said at least two data fields generated at a data rate that is twice a data rate of said single clock source.

20. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 19 wherein said at least two trigger bits are interleaved with said at least two data fields.
